# home

> One CLI for the homelab.

home is an open-source TypeScript/Bun command-line tool that provides people
and local agents with a consistent interface to homelab services, home
automation, media, cloud tools, developer workflow, and operations.

Canonical site: https://home.uptonm.dev
Source: https://github.com/uptonm/home
Documentation: https://home.uptonm.dev/docs

## Documentation

- Introduction: https://home.uptonm.dev/docs
- Getting started: https://home.uptonm.dev/docs/getting-started
- Configuration and secrets: https://home.uptonm.dev/docs/configuration
- Modules: https://home.uptonm.dev/docs/modules
- Agent skills: https://home.uptonm.dev/docs/agent-skills
- Operations: https://home.uptonm.dev/docs/operations
- Development: https://home.uptonm.dev/docs/development

## Core contract

- One binary and one config root.
- Every command supports structured JSON output.
- Modules generate focused local-agent skills from the runtime command registry.
- Commands classify effects as read, write, or destructive.
- Guarded mutations require explicit intent.
